_doc: Robber and police roles. 'gadgets' reference ids in weapons_gadgets.json. 'ability' is the signature role ability (one per role, Rainbow Six style).

robber_roles.name: Professor
robber_roles.summary: Plays from outside the bank with cameras and tech. Must stay undercover.

ability.name: Camera Wall
ability.desc: View hijacked bank and street cameras. Feeds have a delay and limited coverage; police Tech can spot a hijacked feed.

ability.name: Shaped Charge
ability.desc: Blow a hole through a wall or door. Loud.

robber_roles.name: Enforcer
robber_roles.summary: Heavy weapons, suppression and hostage control.

ability.name: Intimidate
ability.desc: Shout down a group of civilians, raising compliance and lowering hero chance in a radius.

ability.name: Network Hack
ability.desc: Hack electronic locks, cameras and controllers. Traceable: police Tech can counter-hack.

robber_roles.name: Medic and Forger
robber_roles.summary: Revives teammates and fakes IDs and uniforms.

ability.name: Field Surgery
ability.desc: Revive downed teammates faster and stop bleeding.

police_roles.name: Commander
police_roles.summary: Runs drone and camera feeds and directs units. No authorization gate over breaches.

ability.name: Tactical Map
ability.desc: Place pings and orders visible to all police and AI units.

ability.name: Hydraulic Ram
ability.desc: Breach a locked door quickly and quietly-ish.

ability.name: Spotter Scope
ability.desc: Mark targets through windows for all police.

police_roles.name: Tech and Drone Operator
police_roles.summary: Scouting, jamming and counter-hacking the robbers' Tech.

ability.name: Counter-Hack
ability.desc: Trace and reverse a robber hack, or reclaim a hijacked camera feed.

police_roles.name: Medic and Hostage Rescue
police_roles.summary: Treats the wounded and extracts hostages.

ability.name: Rescue Carry
ability.desc: Move faster while escorting freed hostages.
